why: hf-discover's README says a /search request is a live query to the Hub's agent-oriented search (agents=true) and, for MCP entries, adds filter=mcp-server, keeping only Spaces whose runtime stage is RUNNING. So the Hub's own answer predicts hf-discover's, and this build can read the Hub where it cannot POST to hf-discover.
note: The Hub search answers to the Space's name and not to the words in its README or tool descriptions: a purpose query returns nothing. That is the Hub's behaviour, not a gap in the Space, and names the limit of what hf-discover can surface for anyone who does not already know the name.
